hero.body: SwiftAgents empowers websites with smart AI assistants that handle live chats, ticketing, and support flows seamlessly. Introduce us to businesses struggling with manual support, and get paid when they go live. It’s that simple.

bullets.agencies: Agency owners and freelancers with active business clients
bullets.anyone: Anyone with a friend, family member, or contact who runs a business with a website

bullets.answers: Their website starts answering customer questions on its own, day and night
bullets.noDevTime: No developer time needed to set it up, SwiftAgents learns the site directly
bullets.liveFast: Live within days, across web chat, WhatsApp, and social messages

refer.title: Refer

demo.title: Demo

payout.rewardCaption: Of whichever plan they pay for
payout.heading: Submit multiple deals
payout.body: You earn 20% of whichever plan the person you refer pays for. The more referrals, the more you earn — it’s that simple.
